newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria inflation down to 19.3 pct in year to July.
newsitem.headline: Algeria inflation down to 19.3 pct in year to July.

text.p: Algeria's inflation rate fell to 19.3 percent for the year to July 1996 from 30 percent in the previous period, the Algerian cabinet said on Wednesday.

In a statement carried by the official news agency APS, Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia said this resulted from "economic growth which has a durable character and is the fruit of a reform process carried out patiently and with perseverance over the past three years."
Gross Domestic Product grew by 4.4 percent in the first half of 1996, the statement said.
No comparison was given with the first half of 1995 but earlier figures showed annual GDP in 1995 at 4.1 percent, reversing falls of 1.8 percent in 1994 and 2.9 percent in 1993.
Outside the oil and gas sector, GDP for the first half 1996 was 3.3 percent, the statement said.
